_comment: PAID ADD-ON VARIANT — use this manifest ONLY on an installation that has bought the Gmail delivery scanner. It is identical to appsscript.json except for the extra https://mail.google.com/ scope, which is the single restricted scope in the whole product. Also set the script property GMAIL_SCAN_ENABLED=true, or the feature stays off no matter what this manifest says. Rename this file's contents into appsscript.json in the Apps Script editor — Google only reads a file literally named appsscript.json.
